item.text:
### (a) Social posts

1. Commercial deep-sea mining will permanently destroy deep-ocean ecosystems. We must keep mining machines out of these irreplaceable habitats and protect the deep sea for good.

2. We refuse to let corporations turn the ocean floor into an industrial sacrifice zone. Commercial deep-sea mining means permanent ecosystem destruction for short-term profit. It must not begin.

3. Once deep-sea mining tears through ancient ocean habitats, they cannot be restored. We choose protection over permanent destruction—and we call on governments to stop commercial mining before it starts.

### (b) Newsletter opening — 109 words

Commercial deep-sea mining will permanently destroy deep-ocean ecosystems. We refuse to treat the ocean floor as an industrial sacrifice zone. These vast, fragile habitats sustain extraordinary life, store carbon, and support the health of our whole planet. Once mining machines tear through them, what is lost cannot be restored. That is why we are calling for a halt to commercial deep-sea mining before it begins. The choice is clear: protect the deep ocean now, or allow permanent destruction for short-term profit. We choose protection, and we invite everyone who values a living ocean to stand with us. Together, we can keep destructive mining out of the deep sea for good.
